definition: A non-zero vector $\boldsymbol{n}$ perpendicular to every vector lying in a plane; any non-zero multiple of it is also a normal.

An equation $\boldsymbol{r} = \boldsymbol{a} + \lambda\boldsymbol{b} + \mu\boldsymbol{c}$, $\lambda, \mu \in \mathbb{R}$, giving every point of the plane through the point with position vector $\boldsymbol{a}$ that contains the non-parallel directions $\boldsymbol{b}$ and $\boldsymbol{c}$.
An equation $ax + by + cz = d$ satisfied by exactly the points of a plane, where $\begin{pmatrix}a\\b\\c\end{pmatrix}$ is a normal to the plane.
